verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI's typed Agent[Deps,Output] generics and Pydantic-model output_type give strong IDE/type-checker level validation and structured-output enforcement, directly supporting build-time error catching. However, several community reports describe structured-output validation being unreliable in practice (LLMs not conforming to schema, retries failing), so the schema-validation promise isn't always delivered smoothly at runtime.
